entry.name: homePage
entry.label: URL to open when launching Brave in app mode.

entry.name: bookmarks
entry.label: JSON array of quick-link objects {name, url}.

entry.name: pin
entry.label: Keep the widget open when it loses focus.

entry.name: bravePath
entry.label: Path or command name for the Brave executable.

entry.name: hideDecorations
entry.label: Remove the title bar from the embedded Brave window.

entry.name: showAddressBar
entry.label: Show address bar when the browser window opens. When false, Brave covers the full widget area automatically after embedding.

entry.name: autoEmbed
entry.label: Automatically embed Brave the first time the widget is opened each session.

entry.name: debugConsole
entry.label: Show the developer console toggle in the toolbar.
